name: SpanishTrans_UQ_Benchmark
description: A Hugging Face dataset and benchmark for Spanish translation with a focus on uncertainty quantification (UQ). It measures translation quality together with calibrated uncertainty estimates from models, enabling evaluation of both predictive accuracy and the quality of confidence/calibration. Useful for research on probabilistic translation models, calibration, and selective prediction in Spanish↔other-language translation.
evaluation_method: BLEU (for translation quality) and calibration metrics (e.g., NLL, ECE) for uncertainty
general_score_metric: BLEU (primary for translation) with accompanying calibration metrics (NLL / ECE)
reputation: Niche, research-focused dataset on Hugging Face for UQ in Spanish translation with limited but growing adoption among calibration and translation researchers.
